alert-dialog.name: Title
alert-dialog.description: The question being asked. Renders as a level-2 heading and labels the dialog via aria-labelledby.

alert-dialog.name: Description
alert-dialog.description: What will happen if the user confirms. Linked to the dialog via aria-describedby.

alert-dialog.name: Cancel button
alert-dialog.description: Ghost button that dismisses without acting. Takes initial focus, and Escape does the same thing.

alert-dialog.name: Action button
alert-dialog.description: The confirming action. Destructive by default; shows a spinner while isActionLoading is set.

alert-dialog.name: Backdrop
alert-dialog.description: Overlay behind the dialog that blocks page interaction. Clicking it does not dismiss.

alert-dialog.name: Dialog surface
alert-dialog.description: The modal panel that holds the title, description, and buttons.

app-shell.name: Page shell
app-shell.description: Outermost application frame that owns page-level navigation, responsive shell behavior, and the main content landmark.

app-shell.name: Skip link
app-shell.description: First focusable element on the page. Visually hidden until focused, then moves focus to the main content area.

app-shell.name: Banner
app-shell.description: The banner slot, for system-wide announcements. Renders above the top nav, inside the banner landmark.

app-shell.name: Top navigation
app-shell.description: The topNav slot, typically TopNav. Below the mobile breakpoint it becomes a compact bar carrying the nav toggle.

app-shell.name: Side navigation
app-shell.description: The sideNav slot, typically SideNav. Inline above the breakpoint, moved into the mobile drawer below it.

app-shell.name: Main content
app-shell.description: The default slot, rendered in the main landmark. Scrolls internally when height is fill, and with the page when it is auto.

app-shell.name: Mobile nav drawer
app-shell.description: Generated below the breakpoint from the nav slots unless mobileNav disables or replaces it. A modal dialog: it traps focus and returns focus to the toggle on close.

aspect-ratio.name: Ratio box
aspect-ratio.description: The outer element that holds the aspect ratio and clips overflow. Carries the `astryx-aspect-ratio` theme target, and the elliptical clip when `shape` is `ellipse`.

aspect-ratio.name: Content slot
aspect-ratio.description: A wrapper that fills the ratio box and positions the child. With `fit` set it also sizes the child; without it the child styles itself.

avatar.name: Photo
avatar.description: The profile image, loaded from the src URL. Shown when available.

avatar.name: Initials
avatar.description: The first letter, digit or emoji of the first and last words of the name; punctuation is skipped. Shown when no photo is available. A name with no letters, digits or emoji shows the default icon instead.

avatar.name: Default icon
avatar.description: A generic person silhouette. Shown when there is no photo or name.

avatar.name: Status dot
avatar.description: A small indicator in the bottom-right corner showing availability (online, away, busy). Each variant pairs colour with a distinct shape so status does not rely on colour alone.

avatar-group.name: Avatars
avatar-group.description: Avatar elements that form the overlapping row. Each can have its own props.

avatar-group.name: Overflow indicator
avatar-group.description: A "+N" circle at the end showing hidden count, or a custom AvatarGroupOverflow slot.

badge.name: Icon
badge.description: An optional leading icon that helps identify the badge type at a glance.

badge.name: Label
badge.description: The text or number shown inside the badge.

banner.name: Banner frame
banner.description: Outer frame that groups the status surface and optional content surface. It carries whole-banner elevation and, for elevated card banners, the radius that shapes that silhouette.

banner.name: Status surface
banner.description: The primary painted surface. It communicates status and contains the icon, title, description, actions, and controls.

banner.name: Icon
banner.description: Automatically set based on the status (info, warning, error, success).

banner.name: Action button
banner.description: A button for the user to act on the message, like "Review" or "Retry".

banner.name: Dismiss button
banner.description: Lets the user close the banner. Enabled by setting isDismissable.

banner.name: Content surface
banner.description: Secondary surface for extra detail below the status surface, like a list of errors. Sits behind an expand/collapse toggle by default; set collapsible to false to keep it visible.

blockquote.name: Rule
blockquote.description: The border on the inline-start edge, drawn with --color-border-emphasized.

blockquote.name: Quotation
blockquote.description: The quoted content, passed in the default slot. Renders inside the <blockquote> element.

blockquote.name: Attribution
blockquote.description: The source, passed as cite. Renders as a <cite> element below the quotation.

bottom-sheet.name: Sheet panel
bottom-sheet.description: Painted surface that rises from the bottom edge and contains the sheet.

bottom-sheet.name: Content area
bottom-sheet.description: Padded, scrollable container that presents the caller-provided sheet content.

bottom-sheet.name: Handle
bottom-sheet.description: Decorative grab affordance and drag region at the top of the panel.

bottom-sheet.name: Scrim
bottom-sheet.description: Backdrop that dims and blocks the page in a scrim-backed presentation.

breadcrumbs.name: Trail
breadcrumbs.description: The ordered list of links from root to current page.

breadcrumbs.name: Item
breadcrumbs.description: A single step in the trail. Renders as a link or plain text for the current page.

breadcrumbs.name: Separator
breadcrumbs.description: The character between items. Defaults to "/" but can be customized.

breadcrumbs.name: Icon
breadcrumbs.description: An optional icon before an item label, like a home icon on the first item.

button.name: Icon
button.description: A leading icon that reinforces the label, like a trash icon on a Delete button.

button.name: Label
button.description: The visible text describing the action. Also used as the accessible name.

button.name: End content
button.description: A trailing badge or icon after the label, like a notification count or dropdown arrow.

button.name: Spinner
button.description: Replaces the icon during loading to show the action is in progress.

button-group.name: Button
button-group.description: One or more Button or IconButton elements that form the connected group.

button-group.name: Divider
button-group.description: A thin border between buttons, rendered automatically by the group.

calendar.name: Calendar root
calendar.description: The container that holds the month header and the day grid.

calendar.name: Month header
calendar.description: The month name and year with navigation arrows to move between months. The arrows mirror automatically under dir="rtl".

calendar.name: Day grid
calendar.description: A 7-column grid of days with column headers for the day names.

calendar.name: Day button
calendar.description: One day in the grid; the control a date is picked with.

calendar.name: Selected day
calendar.description: The currently selected date, highlighted. In range mode, the start and end dates plus the days between them.

calendar.name: Today marker
calendar.description: A subtle indicator on the current date for orientation.

card.name: Container
card.description: The outer box with border, background, border-radius, and padding.

card.name: Content
card.description: Anything rendered in the default slot inside the card. Often a stack of heading, text, and actions.

carousel.name: Scroll container
carousel.description: The horizontal overflow area that holds all items.

carousel.name: Items
carousel.description: The default slot, rendered in a row inside the scroll container. With hasSnap, each item snaps to the start edge.

carousel.name: Fade edges
carousel.description: Gradient fades on the left and right edges that indicate more content is available. Enabled by default. Set hasEdgeFade to false to turn it off.

carousel.name: Navigation buttons
carousel.description: Prev/next buttons that appear when the content can scroll in that direction. Enabled by default. Set hasButtons to false to turn it off.

center.name: Container
center.description: A flexbox wrapper that aligns its children to the center along the chosen axis.

center.name: Content
center.description: Anything passed in the default slot to Center. Typically a card, form, spinner, or empty state message.

chat.name: Message area
chat.description: Scrollable region for messages. Renders the default slot (typically ChatMessageList) in a flex column that pushes content to the bottom when the list is short.

chat.name: Frosted glass dock
chat.description: Sticky or fixed container at the bottom with a backdrop-blur layer. Houses the scroll button and composer.

chat.name: Scroll-to-bottom button
chat.description: Appears when the user scrolls up or new messages arrive. Defaults to ChatLayoutScrollButton. Set showScrollButton to false to hide it, or replace it with the scrollButton slot.

chat.name: Composer
chat.description: The input area for sending messages, typically ChatComposer. Docked at the bottom inside the frosted glass layer.

chat.name: Empty state
chat.description: Centered placeholder shown when no messages exist. Use EmptyState for a consistent look.

chat.name: Avatar
chat.description: A sender avatar rendered beside the message. Typically Avatar with size="md". Hidden for system messages.

chat.name: Name
chat.description: Sender name above the message body. Place on the bubble when using bubbles, or on the message wrapper for raw content.

chat.name: Content
chat.description: The message body: one or more ChatMessageBubble elements, or any free-form slot content like images or tool calls. Wrap non-bubble content in a ghost bubble to align it with the bubble text column.

chat.name: Metadata
chat.description: Timestamp, delivery status, and footer actions below the message. Place on the last bubble or on the message wrapper.

checkbox-input.name: Checkbox
checkbox-input.description: The check box itself: unchecked, checked, or indeterminate.

checkbox-input.name: Label
checkbox-input.description: Text describing what the checkbox controls. Always present for accessibility.

checkbox-input.name: Description
checkbox-input.description: Helper text below the label with additional context.

checkbox-input.name: Status message
checkbox-input.description: An error, warning, or success message below the checkbox.

checkbox-list.name: Group
checkbox-list.description: Container for the labeled checkbox group.

checkbox-list.name: Group label
checkbox-list.description: Text identifying what the checkbox options represent.

checkbox-list.name: Description
checkbox-list.description: Helper text below the group label.

checkbox-list.name: Options list
checkbox-list.description: List containing the available checkbox options.

checkbox-list.name: Option description
checkbox-list.description: Secondary text below an option label.

checkbox-list.name: End content
checkbox-list.description: Caller-provided content at the end of an option row.

checkbox-list.name: Spinner
checkbox-list.description: Loading indicator shown inside the pending checkbox.

checkbox-list.name: Status message
checkbox-list.description: Error, warning, or success message below the group.

citation.name: Container
citation.description: The root wrapper. Accepted source URLs render an anchor; missing or rejected URLs render an inert span.

citation.name: Icon
citation.description: An optional source icon shown before the label text. Accepts a favicon/logo image URL (via source.src) or slot content such as an Astryx <Icon>. Only available in the label variant.

citation.name: Label text
citation.description: The source title, truncated with ellipsis when it exceeds the max width. Shown in the label variant.

citation.name: Number
citation.description: The citation index displayed as a superscript badge. Shown in the number variant.

clickable-card.name: Content
clickable-card.description: Children, which may include nested interactive elements.

code.name: Container
code.description: The semantic code element that contains the inline code content and paints the background, typography, padding, and radius.

code-block.name: Header Bar
code-block.description: Shows the title, visible language label, and copy button when a header is present. A title or visible language label creates the header; the copy button alone floats at the top-end of a headerless block.

code-block.name: Header Title
code-block.description: Groups the optional title, visible language label, and collapsible chevron inside the header bar.

code-block.name: Line Numbers
code-block.description: Numbered gutter along the left edge. Enable with hasLineNumbers.

code-block.name: Highlighted Lines
code-block.description: Background accent on specific lines to draw attention.

code-block.name: Copy Button
code-block.description: Copies the code string to the clipboard. Shown by default.

collapsible.name: Container
collapsible.description: The root that contains one trigger and its controlled content and, in a divided group, paints the item divider.

collapsible.name: Trigger
collapsible.description: The always-visible button that toggles the content. Shows a label and a chevron indicator.

collapsible.name: Chevron
collapsible.description: Animated disclosure arrow. It follows the label by default; chevronPosition="start" moves it ahead of the label, points inward when collapsed (mirrored under RTL), and turns down when expanded.

collapsible.name: Content
collapsible.description: The area that hides or reveals when the trigger is clicked.

collapsible.name: Group container
collapsible.description: The CollapsibleGroup wrapper rendered when dividers are enabled. It contains the coordinated items and carries their density.

command-palette.name: Dialog
command-palette.description: Modal surface that contains the command palette.

command-palette.name: Input
command-palette.description: Search region containing the query field and its supporting visuals.

command-palette.name: Search glyph
command-palette.description: Search symbol rendered by Icon in the default Input.

command-palette.name: Query field
command-palette.description: Native text field used to enter a search query.

command-palette.name: Loading spinner
command-palette.description: Spinner shown in the default Input while a search is pending.

command-palette.name: List
command-palette.description: Scrollable listbox containing the current results or Empty state.

command-palette.name: Item
command-palette.description: Selectable command result rendered inside the List.

command-palette.name: Group
command-palette.description: Optional collection of Items that share a heading.

command-palette.name: Group heading
command-palette.description: Visible heading rendered for a Group.

command-palette.name: Empty
command-palette.description: Message shown when the current result set is empty.

command-palette.name: Footer
command-palette.description: Footer region for default keyboard guidance or caller-provided content.

command-palette.name: Keyboard shortcut
command-palette.description: Painted key badges rendered by Kbd in the default Footer guidance.

complex-selector.name: Field
complex-selector.description: Field shell that provides the label and optional supporting field content.

complex-selector.name: Trigger
complex-selector.description: Control that displays the current value or placeholder and opens the popup.

complex-selector.name: Icon-rendered start icon
complex-selector.description: Optional leading semantic icon or icon component rendered through Icon.

complex-selector.name: Caller-rendered start content
complex-selector.description: Optional arbitrary slot content rendered directly at the start of the trigger.

complex-selector.name: Indicator icon
complex-selector.description: Trailing chevron that rotates to reflect whether the popup is open.

complex-selector.name: Popup
complex-selector.description: Mounted dialog surface that is painted and shown while open and hidden while closed.

context-menu.name: Trigger area
context-menu.description: Caller-provided region that accepts right-click, keyboard context-menu, and long-press input.

context-menu.name: Pointer menu surface
context-menu.description: Cursor-positioned menu panel used by the pointer presentation.

context-menu.name: Pointer action row
context-menu.description: DropdownMenu-owned action, selectable option, or submenu row in the pointer presentation.

context-menu.name: Touch sheet frame
context-menu.description: BottomSheet panel, content area, handle, and optional scrim that host touch actions.

context-menu.name: Touch menu surface
context-menu.description: ContextMenu-owned content panel rendered inside the touch sheet frame.

context-menu.name: Touch action list
context-menu.description: Spacious List that groups data-driven touch actions.

context-menu.name: Touch action row
context-menu.description: ListItem button used for a data-driven action or drill-in entry in the touch presentation.

date-input.name: Label
date-input.description: Text above the input describing what date is expected.

date-input.name: Text input
date-input.description: A field where the user can type a date directly. Parses common formats like MM/DD/YYYY.

date-input.name: Calendar icon
date-input.description: A button that opens the calendar popover for visual date picking.

date-input.name: Calendar popover
date-input.description: A month grid that appears when the icon is clicked or the input is focused.

date-input.name: Clear button
date-input.description: A × button that resets the date value. Shown when clearable is set and a date is present.

date-input.name: Status message
date-input.description: An error, warning, or success message below the input.

date-range-input.name: Label
date-range-input.description: Text above the trigger describing what date range is expected.

date-range-input.name: Field surface
date-range-input.description: Bordered control containing the calendar toggle, range trigger, and end affordances.

date-range-input.name: Trigger button
date-range-input.description: A button showing the formatted range or placeholder. Clicking opens the popover.

date-range-input.name: Calendar icon
date-range-input.description: A trailing icon that also opens the popover.

date-range-input.name: Calendar popover
date-range-input.description: A dual-month calendar grid with range selection and hover preview.

date-range-input.name: Preset sidebar
date-range-input.description: A list of preset range options beside the calendar.

date-range-input.name: Preset button
date-range-input.description: A quick-select action for one preset range, reflecting current and disabled states.

date-range-input.name: Clear button
date-range-input.description: A × button that resets the range to null.

date-range-input.name: Status message
date-range-input.description: An error, warning, or success message below the trigger.

date-time-input.name: Label
date-time-input.description: Text above the input describing what datetime is expected.

date-time-input.name: Segment row
date-time-input.description: The unbordered layout row that holds the two bordered segments and wraps them when its container is narrow.

date-time-input.name: Date input
date-time-input.description: A typed date field with calendar popover on the fine-pointer Astryx surface, a real input type=date in native modes, or a read-only segment opening the Astryx touch sheet under presentation="adaptive-bottom-sheet" on a coarse pointer.

date-time-input.name: Calendar icon
date-time-input.description: A button that opens the active date surface: the platform picker, Astryx calendar popover, or Astryx touch sheet.

date-time-input.name: Date picker
date-time-input.description: The browser/OS picker in native modes, an Astryx month-grid popover on a fine pointer, or the Date panel of the Astryx bottom sheet on a coarse pointer with presentation="adaptive-bottom-sheet".

date-time-input.name: Time input
date-time-input.description: A real input type=time for the default minute-precision native mode, a text/combobox time field when seconds, custom increments, or preset options are requested, or a read-only segment opening accessible time wheels under presentation="adaptive-bottom-sheet" on a coarse pointer.

date-time-input.name: Clock icon
date-time-input.description: The time glyph shown as a leading identifier on the Astryx pointer field and as the picker affordance in native and touch-sheet time segments.

date-time-input.name: Time options popover
date-time-input.description: A list of preset times at the timeOptionInterval cadence. Setting the prop retains Astryx's text/combobox time field even when nativePicker otherwise selects native controls; the Astryx touch sheet uses wheels instead.

date-time-input.name: Time option
date-time-input.description: One selectable preset time in the optional time-options popover.

date-time-input.name: Clear button
date-time-input.description: A × button that resets the datetime value.

date-time-input.name: Status message
date-time-input.description: An error, warning, or success message below the inputs.

dialog.name: Header
dialog.description: Title, optional subtitle, and close button. The title receives focus on open and labels the dialog via aria-labelledby.

dialog.name: Body
dialog.description: The main content area: text, forms, lists, or any layout.

dialog.name: Footer
dialog.description: Action buttons like Save/Cancel or Accept/Decline, aligned to the end.

dialog.name: Backdrop
dialog.description: Semi-transparent overlay behind the dialog that blocks page interaction.

divider.name: Divider group
divider.description: Separator group that arranges one or two rules around an optional label.

divider.name: Rule
divider.description: Painted line segment; a second segment renders when a label is present.

divider.name: Label
divider.description: Optional content displayed between two rule segments.

dropdown-menu.name: Trigger button
dropdown-menu.description: Button that opens and closes the selected menu presentation.

dropdown-menu.name: Trigger indicator icon
dropdown-menu.description: Optional trailing chevron shown by a labeled trigger when hasChevron is enabled.

dropdown-menu.name: Pointer menu surface
dropdown-menu.description: Anchored top-level or nested menu panel used by the pointer presentation.

dropdown-menu.name: Pointer action row
dropdown-menu.description: Action, selectable option, or submenu trigger row in an anchored menu.

dropdown-menu.name: Icon-rendered item icon
dropdown-menu.description: Optional semantic or component icon rendered through Icon at the start of an action row.

dropdown-menu.name: Caller-rendered item start content
dropdown-menu.description: Optional arbitrary slot content rendered directly at the start of an action row.

dropdown-menu.name: Checkbox indicator
dropdown-menu.description: Decorative shared checkbox indicator for a checkbox action row.

dropdown-menu.name: Radio indicator
dropdown-menu.description: Decorative shared radio indicator with an additional menu-owned target.

dropdown-menu.name: Pointer section heading
dropdown-menu.description: Heading that labels a group of rows in an anchored menu: a data-driven section or a compound DropdownMenuGroup.

dropdown-menu.name: Pointer divider
dropdown-menu.description: Divider between groups in an anchored menu.

dropdown-menu.name: Pointer submenu indicator icon
dropdown-menu.description: Trailing chevron that identifies an action row as a nested flyout trigger.

dropdown-menu.name: Touch sheet frame
dropdown-menu.description: BottomSheet panel, content area, handle, and optional scrim that host touch actions.

dropdown-menu.name: Touch menu surface
dropdown-menu.description: Menu-owned content panel rendered inside the touch sheet frame.

dropdown-menu.name: Touch heading
dropdown-menu.description: Current action-sheet title, updated when a nested action view is opened.

dropdown-menu.name: Touch action list
dropdown-menu.description: Spacious List that groups actions in the touch presentation.

dropdown-menu.name: Touch action row
dropdown-menu.description: ListItem button used for an action or drill-in entry in the touch presentation.

dropdown-menu.name: Touch divider
dropdown-menu.description: Divider between action groups in the touch presentation.

empty-state.name: Icon
empty-state.description: A visual cue above the title that reinforces the context, like a search icon for no results.

empty-state.name: Title
empty-state.description: Primary message explaining what is empty: "No projects yet" not "No data".

empty-state.name: Description
empty-state.description: Additional context explaining why it is empty or what the user can do.

empty-state.name: Actions
empty-state.description: One or two buttons guiding the user to a next step, like "Create project" or "Clear filters".

field.name: Label
field.description: Text identifying the field. Always rendered for accessibility, optionally hidden visually.

field.name: Description
field.description: Helper text between the label and input explaining what to enter.

field.name: Control slot
field.description: A custom, native, or third-party control that does not already render a field shell.

field.name: Status message
field.description: Inline validation feedback showing error, warning, or success with a message.

field.name: Optional/Required indicator
field.description: Badge next to the label showing whether the field is optional or required.

field.name: Label tooltip
field.description: Info icon at the end of the label with a tooltip explaining the field.

field-status.name: Message box
field-status.description: Painted container for the validation feedback.

field-status.name: Detached icon
field-status.description: Leading status glyph shown only by the detached variant.

file-input.name: Label
file-input.description: Text that identifies the field. Always rendered for accessibility even when visually hidden.

file-input.name: Description
file-input.description: Helper text between the label and the drop zone explaining accepted formats or size limits.

file-input.name: Drop zone
file-input.description: The clickable area for file selection. In dropzone mode, also accepts dragged files.

file-input.name: Upload icon
file-input.description: An upload-to-tray icon in the drop zone hinting at the upload action.

file-input.name: Placeholder
file-input.description: Hint text shown when no files are selected.

file-input.name: File name display
file-input.description: Shows the name(s) of selected files.

file-input.name: Clear button
file-input.description: A close button that removes selected files and returns focus to the input.

file-input.name: Spinner
file-input.description: Loading indicator that appears during async upload actions.

file-input.name: Status message
file-input.description: Validation feedback showing error, warning, or success with a message.

form-layout.name: Form title
form-layout.description: Heading that describes the purpose of the form.

form-layout.name: Fields
form-layout.description: Input components with labels for collecting user data.

form-layout.name: Footer
form-layout.description: Contains confirmation buttons such as Submit or Cancel.

grid.name: Grid container
grid.description: Two-dimensional layout container that arranges caller-supplied items in rows and columns.

grid.name: Spanning item
grid.description: Optional GridSpan wrapper that changes one item's column or row participation.

hover-card.name: Trigger
hover-card.description: The element that opens the hover card on hover or focus: a button, link, or inline text.

hover-card.name: Card
hover-card.description: The floating overlay with the preview content, anchored to the trigger.

hover-card.name: Body
hover-card.description: The main content area: profile info, link summary, or any rich content.

hover-card.name: Actions
hover-card.description: Optional buttons inside the card for follow-up actions like Follow or Message.

icon.name: Glyph
icon.description: Visual symbol rendered for the selected icon.

input-group.name: Prefix addon
input-group.description: Content before the input (text, icon, or button).

input-group.name: Input
input-group.description: The main input element (TextInput, NumberInput, TimeInput, DateInput, Typeahead, Selector, or MultiSelector).

input-group.name: Suffix addon
input-group.description: Content after the input (text, icon, or button).

input-group.name: Status message
input-group.description: An error, warning, or success message below the group.

kbd.name: Shortcut
kbd.description: Group that presents the complete keyboard shortcut and its accessible name.

kbd.name: Key badge
kbd.description: Painted key badge rendered once for each key in the shortcut.

layout.name: Layout container
layout.description: General layout primitive that places the header, start, content, end, and footer slots.

layout.name: Header
layout.description: Optional LayoutHeader region supplied by the caller, typically in the header slot.

layout.name: Panel
layout.description: Optional LayoutPanel region supplied by the caller in the start or end slot.

layout.name: Content area
layout.description: Optional LayoutContent region supplied by the caller in the content slot.

layout.name: Footer
layout.description: Optional LayoutFooter region supplied by the caller, typically in the footer slot.

lightbox.name: Viewer overlay
lightbox.description: Full-viewport dialog overlay that contains the active media and controls.

lightbox.name: Media
lightbox.description: Active image or video presented inside the viewer.

lightbox.name: Previous button
lightbox.description: Gallery button that moves to the previous media item.

lightbox.name: Next button
lightbox.description: Gallery button that moves to the next media item.

lightbox.name: Caption
lightbox.description: Caller-provided caption displayed below the active media.

lightbox.name: Counter
lightbox.description: Current position and total shown in gallery mode.

link.name: Label
link.description: The visible text of the link.

link.name: Right icon
link.description: Icon placed after the label to indicate an action affordance.

link.name: Left icon
link.description: Icon placed before the label to represent meaning.

list.name: List items
list.description: Individual entries, which may include icons or images.

list.name: Item description
list.description: Additional detail for an individual list item.

markdown.name: Document
markdown.description: Root container for block or inline Markdown content.

markdown.name: Heading
markdown.description: Rendered semantic heading block; a custom heading renderer replaces the built-in part.

markdown.name: Paragraph
markdown.description: Rendered paragraph block; a custom paragraph renderer replaces the default part.

markdown.name: List
markdown.description: Ordered, unordered, or task-list block rendered from Markdown items.

markdown.name: Code block
markdown.description: Fenced code block; a custom code renderer replaces the default part.

markdown.name: Blockquote
markdown.description: Quoted block; a custom blockquote renderer replaces the default part.

markdown.name: Table
markdown.description: Table block rendered from Markdown rows and columns; its Table child owns horizontal scrolling.

markdown.name: Divider
markdown.description: Horizontal rule block; a custom hr renderer replaces the default part.

markdown.name: Image
markdown.description: Block image or unsafe-URL fallback; a custom image renderer replaces a safe default image.

metadata-list.name: Title
metadata-list.description: Optional title for the metadata list.

metadata-list.name: Label
metadata-list.description: The key label for each metadata entry.

metadata-list.name: Metadata
metadata-list.description: The value displayed in various formats.

stepper.name: Stepper
stepper.description: The ordered list holding the steps. Owns the orientation and the indicator placement the whole flow is laid out on.

stepper.name: Frame
stepper.description: The layout frame that groups the ordered steps with the optional compact summary shown at narrow widths.

stepper.name: Compact summary
stepper.description: The optional row a horizontal Stepper adds directly beneath the track once it is too narrow to label every step. horizontalOptions.collapsedVariant chooses a label with Previous/Next controls, the label alone, or no row for a bare progress track. The on-track layout keeps its indicators on the rail instead of repeating the active indicator beside the label. Every step keeps its name in the accessible sequence at any width.

stepper.name: Step
stepper.description: One step in the flow, and the element carrying its status. Wraps the indicator, label, description, and the track segments belonging to it.

stepper.name: Progress bar
stepper.description: A 4px segmented bar per step. Filled for completed and active steps. Advancing one step grows the fill along the track it just covered, so the movement reads as progress rather than a bar changing color. Every other change applies at once: going back, jumping forward by more than one step, mounting mid-flow, and any change at all under prefers-reduced-motion. Where a span is drawn by more than one segment (the on-track layouts split it between two steps, three when a content slot sits between them), the segments run in track order at one constant speed, so the fill reads as a single line growing rather than pieces lighting in turn.

stepper.name: Connector
stepper.description: The track drawn between indicators in the on-track layouts. Each connector paints an unfilled line and, over it, the accent fill covering the progress made. How many pieces a connector is drawn from is an implementation detail of the layout, not a themeable part; use --step-connector-gap to hold the track off the indicator.

stepper.name: Indicator
stepper.description: A numbered badge, a check, or any custom icon. Controlled via the indicator prop.

stepper.name: Description
stepper.description: Supporting text below the label with additional context.

switch.description: Container arranging the switch, label, and feedback.

switch.name: Spinner

table.name: Sort priority

table.name: Default empty state

table.name: Footer section

text.name: Truncation tooltip

text-area.name: Description

text-area.name: Input container

text-area.name: Text area

text-area.name: Placeholder

text-area.name: Spinner
text-area.description: Loading indicator shown at the end of the input container.

text-area.name: Status icon
text-area.description: Error, warning, or success icon shown inside the input.

text-area.name: Character counter
text-area.description: Current and maximum character counts shown inside the input container.

text-area.name: Field status message
text-area.description: Attached or detached error, warning, or success message associated with the field.

text-area.name: Tooltip status message

text-input.name: Description
text-input.description: Helper text between the label and the input that provides additional context or formatting hints.

text-input.name: Status icon

thumbnail.name: Image
thumbnail.description: The preview image, displayed as a square with cover fit.

thumbnail.name: Placeholder
thumbnail.description: An image silhouette icon shown when no src is provided.

thumbnail.name: Upload overlay

thumbnail.name: Skeleton

time-input.name: Clock icon

time-input.name: Time control

time-input.name: Status icon

time-input.name: Spinner

timer.name: Elapsed time

timestamp.name: Formatted text

timestamp.name: Hover card

timestamp.name: Hover card row

timestamp.name: Copy button
timestamp.description: Per-row copy-to-clipboard button in the hover card; copies that row's formatted value.
